description: Phase 1 Quick Wins: Remove Emergent.sh script, PostHog client SDK, CF Web Analytics fetcher, and subset Google Fonts to eliminate ~200ms TBT and ~800ms TTI. These are all changes to apps/frontend/index.html and apps/frontend/tailwind.config.js.
steps: In apps/frontend/index.html: Remove the entire `<style>#emergent-badge,...` block (the CSS that hides Emergent badges) - it is a standalone <style> element in the <head>
In apps/frontend/index.html: Remove the `<link rel="dns-prefetch" href="https://assets.emergent.sh" />` line

In apps/frontend/index.html: Remove the entire `(function deferThirdParty(){...})();` script block in the <body> that loads emergent-main.js. This is the IIFE wrapped in a <script> tag after the module src tag

In apps/frontend/index.html: Remove the entire `(function deferPosthog(){...})();` and the `function initPosthog(){...}` script block. This is the second <script> block after the emergent one. Keep the dns-prefetch links for posthog (Zaraz will handle it)

In apps/frontend/index.html: Remove the CF Web Analytics fetcher script in <head> - the <script> block that calls `fetch('/api/cf-web-analytics/config', ...)` and dynamically creates the beacon script

In apps/frontend/index.html: Change the Google Fonts URL from `family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&display=swap` to `family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap` (remove Inter) in BOTH the media=print link AND the noscript fallback link

In apps/frontend/tailwind.config.js: Update fontFamily.sans from `["'Space Grotesk'", "Inter", "-apple-system", "BlinkMacSystemFont", "'Segoe UI'", "sans-serif"]` to `["'Space Grotesk'", "system-ui", "-apple-system", "BlinkMacSystemFont", "'Segoe UI'", "sans-serif"]` (replace Inter with system-ui)

In apps/frontend/index.html: In the inline critical CSS <style> block, update the body font-family from `'Space Grotesk','Inter',system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif` to `'Space Grotesk',system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif`
acceptance_criteria: No references to emergent.sh remain in index.html (no script, no CSS, no dns-prefetch)
No PostHog client SDK init code remains in index.html (no deferPosthog IIFE, no initPosthog function)
No cf-web-analytics fetch script remains in index.html
Google Fonts URL only loads Space Grotesk (no Inter)
tailwind.config.js fontFamily.sans uses system-ui instead of Inter
The dns-prefetch for us.i.posthog.com and us-assets.i.posthog.com are preserved
The <!--CF_ANALYTICS_BEACON--> placeholder comment at the end of body is preserved
verification: Run `pnpm --filter @workspace/syrabit test` and confirm all tests pass
Run `pnpm --filter @workspace/syrabit build:client` and confirm build succeeds
Verify no 'emergent' references in index.html with grep
Verify no 'initPosthog' or 'deferPosthog' in index.html with grep
Verify no 'cf-web-analytics' fetch in index.html with grep
findings: All 623 tests pass. Build succeeds. Removed ~112 lines of third-party script code (emergent, posthog SDK, cf-web-analytics). Font subsetting reduces network requests (no Inter download). Preserved all required elements per acceptance criteria.
